name: sg-permit-notes
description: SG1 — housing-type-conditional permit/compliance language. Switches the active plan's `category.housingType` to Condominium via the store, regenerates the Drawing set (cover sheet general notes) and the Report (compliance section), and asserts the MCST/building-management approval text appears while the HDB permit text does not. openDrawingSet()/openReport() open a new window and call document.write; window.open is intercepted (stub capturing the written HTML) so no real popup spawns.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: set-housing-type-condo
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); const withCat = (plan) => ({ ...plan, category: { housingType: 'Condominium', projectName: 'Sky Habitat', apartmentType: 'Loft' } }); window.__store.setState({ floorPlan: withCat(s.floorPlan), baselinePlan: withCat(s.baselinePlan) }); })()

steps.name: assert-housing-type-stuck
steps.eval: (function(){ const c = window.__store.getState().floorPlan.category; if (c?.housingType !== 'Condominium') throw new Error('housingType did not stick on the live plan'); })()

steps.name: patch-window-open
steps.eval: window.__capturedHtml = null; window.__origWindowOpen = window.open; window.open = function () { return { document: { write: function (html) { window.__capturedHtml = html }, close: function () {} }, close: function () {}, focus: function () {}, print: function () {} }; };

steps.name: click-drawing-set
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Drawing set')); if (!btn) throw new Error('Drawing set button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-drawing-set-captured
steps.failMessage: openDrawingSet() never wrote HTML via the intercepted window.open

steps.name: assert-drawing-set-condo-notes
steps.eval: (function(){ const html = window.__capturedHtml; window.open = window.__origWindowOpen; if (!html.includes('MCST')) throw new Error('missing the Condominium MCST/building-management approval note on the drawing-set cover sheet'); if (html.includes('written HDB permit')) throw new Error('drawing-set cover sheet still renders the HDB-permit text for a Condominium plan'); if (!html.includes('Professional Engineer')) throw new Error('missing the PE-endorsement note for structural work'); })()

steps.name: patch-window-open-report
steps.eval: window.__capturedHtml = null; window.__origWindowOpen = window.open; window.open = function () { return { document: { write: function (html) { window.__capturedHtml = html }, close: function () {} }, close: function () {}, focus: function () {}, print: function () {} }; };

steps.name: click-report
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Report') || b.textContent.includes('report')); if (!btn) throw new Error('Report button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-report-captured
steps.failMessage: openReport() never wrote HTML via the intercepted window.open

steps.name: assert-report-gates-hdb-section
steps.eval: (function(){ const html = window.__capturedHtml; window.open = window.__origWindowOpen; if (html.includes('HDB compliance hints')) throw new Error('report still renders the HDB-only compliance section for a Condominium plan'); if (!html.includes('Renovation compliance notes')) throw new Error('missing the Condominium/Landed pointer section (Renovation compliance notes)'); if (!html.includes('MCST')) throw new Error('missing the MCST pointer line in the report'); })()
